page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.80-160 is a compute-focused instance powered by the 64-bit Arm Ampere Altra processor operating at a fixed 3.0 GHz clock speed. The server features 80 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core allocation, supplying 80 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading. It is equipped with 160.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance configuration includes one complimentary public IPv4 address and contains no bundled GPUs.

The server does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external network-attached block volumes for system operating files and persistent storage needs. Because each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, the architecture avoids resource contention and latency spikes common to hyper-threaded hardware. System deployment on this instance necessitates an arm64-compatible operating system and software stack, which presents an architecture-specific tradeoff for legacy x86 environments.

With its 80 independent cores and moderate memory footprint, VM.Standard.A1.Flex.80-160 provides high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized workloads. It is well-suited for distributed microservices, CI/CD compilation clusters, video transcoding pipelines, web serving infrastructure, and compute-bound batch analytics.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.80-160 is an arm64-based compute instance built on the Ampere Altra platform operating at 3.0 GHz. It delivers 80 dedicated physical cores with single-threaded execution, mapping directly to 80 vCPUs, alongside 160.0 GB of memory. This configuration establishes a compute-oriented 1:2 core-to-memory ratio, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or GPU hardware, relying on external network-attached block volumes for persistent data, and includes one public IPv4 address. By avoiding hyper-threading contention across its 80 physical cores, the server offers strong compute density and predictable throughput. VM.Standard.A1.Flex.80-160 is suited for scale-out parallel workloads, including distributed containerized microservices, continuous integration pipelines, batch data processing, web serving, and media transcoding.
